name: Matinan Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Mountains of northern sulawesi
description: A chunky, drab flycatcher with a heavy hooked bill. Has a gray head with indistinct pale marking around the eye.

name: Island Whistler
rangeDescription: Moluccas including kai islands, aru islands, and raja ampat islands (off western new guinea)
description: A rather drab, medium-sized bird of wooded habitats on small islands. Gray head, white throat, brown back and very pale brown underparts with slightly darker brown smudges on the sides of the chest.

name: Neblina Metaltail
rangeDescription: Andes of southern ecuador (loja) and northern peru (piura and cajamarca)
description: Scarce high Andean hummingbird found only in remote areas of southern Ecuador and northern Peru. Male is green with a rosy throat and a white dot behind the eye; tail is green below and may appear bronzy or bluish above depending on the light.

name: Tschudi's Nightjar
rangeDescription: Arid littoral of western peru and far northern chile
description: Fairly common but nocturnal bird of lowland desert with scattered low bushes and agricultural areas with hedges and brush. Sleeps during the day on the ground or on a low shady perch; when flushed flies with quick stiff wingbeats and short glides.

name: Gray-headed Imperial-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Montane forest of sulawesi
description: A large pigeon with a gray head and underside, except for a rufous undertail. Note the wide, pale gray bar on the tail.

name: Long-toed Stint
rangeDescription: Northeastern palearctic; winters southeastern asia to philippines and australia
description: Tiny and slender “peep” of inland and coastal wetlands, where it is often found in well-vegetated areas such as fields and flooded meadows. Unlike most other small sandpipers in the region, this species has a distinctly long-winged and slender-bodied appearance.

name: Chestnut-flanked Sparrowhawk
rangeDescription: Nigeria to the congo river basin
description: A tiny hawk with a dark slaty back, an owl-like facial expression, and dense red-brown and gray barring on the breast with redder flanks. These dark colors contrast with the hawk’s yellowish face and legs.

name: Salvadori's Teal
rangeDescription: Mountain streams of new guinea
description: An unusual duck of alpine lakes and mountain streams. Very distinctive elongated shape with yellow bill, dark head, strong barring on the body and a pointy tail which is cocked when startled.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Moluccan Goshawk
rangeDescription: Northern moluccas (bacan, halmahera, ternate, and morotai)
description: A fairly large, dark gray goshawk with deep rufous underparts, including barred thighs on adults. Yellow eyes, bill base, and legs.

name: Gilbert's Honeyeater
rangeDescription: Southwestern western australia
description: Small honeyeater of eucalypt forests of southwestern Australia. Light olive above, whitish below, with black head broken by white band behind the eye and narrow white arc above it.

name: Oahu Amakihi
rangeDescription: Humid montane forest of oahu
description: A small Hawaiian honeycreeper of forests on Oahu. Males are bright yellow and females are grayer with two whitish wingbars.

name: Algerian Nuthatch
rangeDescription: Montane oak-cedar forest of northeastern algeria
description: A small nuthatch endemic to a tiny area in northeastern Algeria with a sharply demarcated white eyebrow. Female similar to the male but slightly duller with a dark gray forehead.

name: Nilgiri Flowerpecker
rangeDescription: Western ghats and coastal southwestern india
description: Small plain gray-brown bird with a slightly curved bill. Nearly identical to Plain Flowerpecker, but ranges do not overlap.

name: West African Batis
rangeDescription: Humid forest of sierra leone to southern cameroon and gabon
description: A classically patterned batis of forest, forest edges, villages, and towns in tropical lowlands and foothills. Males have white underparts bisected by a black chest band, mostly black upperparts with a broken white eye-line, white on the nape, scalloped white and gray on the back, and a white wingbar that extends to the tip of the wings in the secondary flight feathers.

name: Fire-bellied Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Sierra leone and southern guinea to southern nigeria and southwestern cameroon
description: A large, long-billed woodpecker with an olive back, a red rump, a bold facial pattern, and heavily marked underparts with a bright red central belly stripe. The crown and back of the head are black in the female and red in males.

name: Bare-eyed Pigeon
rangeDescription: Arid coastal northeastern colombia to northern venezuela and adjacent islands
description: Large, pale pigeon, unmistakeable if seen well, with large pale blue ocular ring and prominent white wing patches. Occurs in pairs or in small to large groups; mainly seen in trees, tops of cactuses, or in flight.

name: Madagascar Partridge
rangeDescription: Madagascar; introduced réunion
description: Dark, chunky, medium-sized ground-dwelling bird. Distinctive male has a complex and beautiful pattern, while female is plainer and browner.

name: Mountain Serpent-Eagle
rangeDescription: Mountains of northern borneo
description: Small, striking eagle with broad, rounded wings. Broad white wing bands and base to tail prominent in flight.

name: Talaud Rail
rangeDescription: Karekelong island (talaud archipelago)
description: An unmistakable, little-known hulking forest rail with a large yellow bill, an all-rufous head and neck, forest-green upperparts, and a blackish belly. Also note the striking pale blaze behind the eye.

name: Western Shrike-tit
rangeDescription: Southwestern western australia
description: Small bird with short, heavy bill. Green above, with a mainly yellow front except for a broad white belly strip.
